name: Venduto
tagline: Runs your secondhand listings from first enquiry through to an agreed sale
description: Sells for you on European resale platforms, taking a listing from first enquiry to an agreed price. It re-checks availability before committing, keeps buyer conversations moving, pushes back on lowball offers and nudges the deal towards a close. Because it can agree sales on your behalf, it is worth supervising.
author: SuperTost100
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
